title: Build a shelter before the storm (strict rule, long deadline)
description: Same terrain and strict shelter rule as shelter_01, but the deadline is extended to turn 60 (turn_limit 80). Measures whether the failure mode in the original was purely budget-driven: given more time, can the strict-built shelter be completed?
goal: Build a valid shelter (≥ 3×3 floor, closed walls and roof, all placed blocks) and be inside it at or before turn 60.
notes: Same strict rule as shelter_01 — every boundary cell must be placed by agent.
Deadline extended from 30 → 60 (with 20-turn grace to 80) to test whether pure-built shelter is achievable when budget is adequate.

Expected minimum turns for a completed solo pure-built shelter: travel to trees (~15) + break 15 wood (~15) + travel back (~15) + break 9 grass for floor (~9) + place 30 blocks (~30) = ~84 turns. Hence turn_limit 80 is still tight; a creature efficient with routing / material choice may succeed, an inefficient one will exhaust the budget.
